South Point Shopping Mall in Manukau is a convenient and well-laid-out centre that offers a great mix of everyday essentials and dining options. One of the standout features is the parking — there’s plenty available, with both open-air and covered spaces, so whether it’s sunny or raining, you’re sorted. It’s easy to get a park and access the shops without too much walking, which is a big plus if you’re in a hurry or shopping with kids.

Inside the mall, there’s a solid selection of food outlets catering to different tastes, from local favourites to takeaway options. Whether you’re grabbing a quick lunch or sitting down for dinner, you’ll find something that hits the spot. The restaurants are clean, welcoming, and usually not overcrowded.

In terms of essentials, the mall includes a Countdown supermarket which is well-stocked and makes it easy to grab your groceries in one go. There’s also an ATM on site, which is convenient for quick cash withdrawals. Other services include a barber shop that’s reasonably priced and does a good job, and dolloar shop is good too. Malaysian food is good here too and my fav is burger fuel

While it’s not as large or flashy as some of the bigger malls in Auckland, South Point has a relaxed atmosphere and covers all the basics in one easy-to-navigate location. It’s a great stop for locals or anyone passing through Manukau who wants hassle-free shopping, dining, and services all under one roof.

This Review is for the Crush Beauty’s Annual Cosmetic sale that was back after a Covid hiatus and this year it was jointly held with Bendon.
Many people had turned up there on the day at 7am for the 9am opening. As probably anticipated, the day started with extremely long queues, not to mention the traffic congestion caused on the Airpark Road.
After over an hour’s queueing, people were let in by a lone security guard in a batch of about 20 people at a time. We were all required to scan their bar code before entering the warehouse.
And then Voilà we were inside…to a scene of utter chaos and disorganisation. It was a very poorly organised warehouse that was lined/cluttered with cartons on tables filled with a jumble of poor quality makeup products and deodorants; most of the cosmetics were testers or rejects or returned makeup products. They were really cheap looking stuff.
The array of Bendon lingerie displayed were even more pathetic. They looked like Returns or/and Used lingerie. Most of the bras were in the wrong boxes and not in the allocated cartons with sizes marked.
The range of fragrances presented were the cheaper eau de toilettes that are the slow moving ones and not in demand. They were certainly not the good stuff.
Sorry, Crush beauty and Bendon team, it was extremely embarrassing to see what was on display and it was even more annoying that I had stood in the queue for well over an hour and a half for this pathetic demonstration of chaos and mess.

The Adidas store in Onehunga offers a fantastic shopping experience for anyone looking for quality sportswear at great prices. Located in the heart of the Onehunga Dress Smart outlet precinct, the store is spacious, well-organised, and easy to navigate. From the moment you step inside, the clean layout and clear signage make browsing a breeze. The store carries a wide range of Adidas products, including performance gear, casual streetwear, sneakers, and accessories for men, women, and kids. Whether you’re after running shoes, training clothes, or lifestyle pieces from the Adidas Originals collection, there’s something for everyone.

One of the biggest draws of this location is the pricing. As an outlet store, there are regular discounts and deals across the entire range, with some items marked down significantly from their retail prices. It’s a great place to score high-quality Adidas gear without breaking the bank. The stock turnover is frequent too, so there’s always something new to check out on each visit.

Customer service at the Onehunga store is consistently strong. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to help with sizing, availability, or product advice. They strike a good balance between being helpful and letting you browse in peace. The fitting rooms are clean and spacious, and the checkout process is fast and efficient—even when the store gets busy on weekends.

Overall, the Adidas Onehunga store is well worth visiting, whether you’re a die-hard Adidas fan or just looking for a good deal on top-quality sportswear. With its strong product range, outlet pricing, and excellent service, it’s one of the best stops for athletic wear in the Auckland area.

The Arcade – A Hidden Gem in Devonport

Nestled in the heart of Devonport’s charming village, The Arcade is a boutique retail and wellness hub that blends heritage character with modern-day comforts. Just steps from the ferry terminal on Victoria Road, it offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for both locals and visitors.

Home to a curated selection of businesses, The Arcade is known for its high-quality, personalized services. Arcade Day Spa provides eco-conscious beauty treatments in a peaceful setting, with everything from facials to lash enhancements delivered by experienced professionals. Nearby, Arcadia Hair Stylist is a favorite among locals for precision cuts and styling, led by the talented June Sun, formerly of Servilles.

Set against Devonport’s scenic seaside backdrop, The Arcade offers a uniquely local experience—whether you're in need of a little pampering, a fresh new look, or simply a stroll through one of Auckland’s most picturesque neighborhoods.
